T.expanded_type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k) (cuts : (N : ℕ) → RiffleUpperV2.InfiniteCuts k N),
      RiffleUpperV2.ArbitrarilyFineApproximation μ cuts →
        (∀ (t : ℝ),
            0 ≤ t →
              RiffleUpperV2.criticalTime μ < ENNReal.ofReal t →
                Filter.Tendsto
                  (fun (N : ℕ) =>
                    RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw ((cuts N).take (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N t)))
                      (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N))
                  Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
          ∀ (ε : ℝ),
            0 < ε →
              ε < 1 →
                Filter.limsup (fun (N : ℕ) => RiffleUpperV2.mixingTime (cuts N) ε / ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log ↑N))
                    Filter.atTop ≤
                  RiffleUpperV2.criticalTime μ

REmpiricalBound.expanded_type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T η0 g0 γ0 : ℝ),
      0 < T →
        0 < η0 →
          0 < g0 →
            0 < γ0 →
              ∃ (ρ0 : ℝ),
                0 < ρ0 ∧
                  ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
                    0 < ρ →
                      ρ ≤ ρ0 →
                        ∃ (c : ℝ),
                          0 < c ∧
                            ∃ (N0 : ℕ) (hN0 : 2 ≤ N0),
                              ∀ (N : ℕ) (hN : N0 ≤ N) (K : ℕ),
                                ↑K ≤ T * Real.log ↑N →
                                  ∀ (Q : PMF (RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K)),
                                    RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.randomInverseLaw Q)
                                        (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) ≤
                                      (RiffleUpperV2.probability Q fun (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) =>
                                          ¬(RiffleUpperV2.EmpiricalNegativeMargin N 0 cuts ⋯ η0 ∧
                                              RiffleUpperV2.LocalGood cuts ⋯ g0 γ0 ρ 0 (↑K / Real.log ↑N))) +
                                        ↑N ^ (-c)

REmpirical.name: RiffleUpperV2.ProfileUpper.randomEmpiricalUpper
REmpirical.expanded_type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T η0 g0 γ0 : ℝ),
      0 < T →

                                      (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N))

source_and_adversarial_review.model: Concrete fixed-count physical inverse law, chronological column order, stable-sort graph bridge, and half-L1 TV.
source_and_adversarial_review.quantifiers: Original N scale in all subdecks; all integer endpoints and theta in [3,4]; uniform E parameter order; arbitrary fixed partition; g and gamma before decreasing rho; coherent horizons and extended infinite thresholds; arbitrary joint random cut law.
source_and_adversarial_review.hard_chain: Actual physical/graph bridge, arbitrary overlap fibers, product-event truncation, reserved post-anchor smoothing, direct fourth-power density, full localization/class losses, original-scale F, exact natural sorted-history law and removable copies, auxiliary disintegration without enlarged filtration, three block regimes, initial and terminal histories, adapted moments, 2k cover, deterministic restart, fixed-partition transfer, critical/mixing semantics, random averaging.
source_and_adversarial_review.auxiliary_numerical_choices: Certified full-H constant 1/24, hypergeometric atom constant 16, F exponent eta/8, scalar bound 4 log k and terminal rounding loss 14 log k/log N have explicit downstream absorption proofs preserving all public endpoints.

preservation.scope: Read-only preservation check. Rebuilding reused lower model/helper sources in U13 overlay is not new lower-bound theorem work.

scope_limits: Acceptance is for the six frozen upper endpoints, not a new lower-bound theorem or a stronger cutoff statement.
Critical-time convergence is strictly above the threshold; infinite thresholds retain the extended semantics.
Public mathematical hypotheses in the exact expanded types remain hypotheses; there is no hidden first-moment, conditional-law, localization, moment, or TV certificate premise.
